render_mesh_image: render a 3D mesh image using MuJoCo physics with a given quaternion rotation and light direction
compute_tangent_vectors: compute image tangent vectors by finite differences for quaternion rotation and light direction perturbations
get_normal_vectors: get vectors normal to a unit vector using singular value decomposition
run_data_writer: run the data writer CLI to render images and save shards with latents and tangents to NPZ files
review_render_function: review the render function that builds a MuJoCo MJCF scene and renders a 3D mesh
